+def test_named_text_wrapper_close_keeps_shared_buffer_open():
+    buffer = BytesIO()
+    wrappers = [
+        _NamedTextIOWrapper(buffer, "<test>", "w"),
+        _NamedTextIOWrapper(buffer, "<test>", "w"),
+    ]
+
+    for wrapper, value in zip(wrappers, ("first", "second")):
+        wrapper.write(value)
+        wrapper.close()
+        assert not buffer.closed
+
+    assert buffer.getvalue() == b"firstsecond"
+
+
+def test_runner_streams_remain_usable_after_finalization():
+    runner = CliRunner()
+
+    with runner.isolation() as streams:
+        click.echo("stdout")
+        click.echo("stderr", err=True)
+
+    gc.collect()
+
+    assert [stream.getvalue() for stream in streams] == [
+        b"stdout\n",
+        b"stderr\n",
+        b"stdout\nstderr\n",
+    ]
+
+
+def test_repeated_invoke_restores_and_isolates_retained_streams():
+    runner = CliRunner()
+    logger = logging.Logger("click.testing.lifecycle", logging.ERROR)
+    handlers = []
+    original_streams = sys.stdin, sys.stdout, sys.stderr
+
+    @click.command()
+    def cli():
+        handler = logging.StreamHandler()
+        handlers.append(handler)
+        logger.addHandler(handler)
+
+        try:
+            thread = threading.Thread(target=logger.error, args=("logged",))
+            thread.start()
+            thread.join()
+        finally:
+            logger.removeHandler(handler)
+
+        click.echo("stdout")
+        raise RuntimeError("failed")
+
+    results = [runner.invoke(cli), runner.invoke(cli)]
+
+    for result in results:
+        assert result.stdout == "stdout\n"
+        assert result.stderr == "logged\n"
+        assert result.output == "logged\nstdout\n"
+        assert isinstance(result.exception, RuntimeError)
+
+    retained_buffers = [handler.stream.buffer for handler in handlers]
+    handlers.clear()
+    results.clear()
+    gc.collect()
+
+    assert (sys.stdin, sys.stdout, sys.stderr) == original_streams
+    assert [buffer.getvalue() for buffer in retained_buffers] == [
+        b"logged\n",
+        b"logged\n",
+    ]
+
